scope: Audit of existing captured bodies only; no new GETs, forecasts or disposition.

yougov_cfc.source: YouGov survey; City Forward Collective/CFC Action Fund sponsor press release hosted by Urban Milwaukee (not staff reporting).
yougov_cfc.body_evidence: Release: “The survey is of Wisconsin adults, not exclusively registered or likely voters.” Online survey weighted to represent Wisconsin adults by demographic and political characteristics; n=2,000 adults, governor item n=1,715; Crowley 46%, Tiffany 42%, unsure 9%, not planning to vote 2%.
yougov_cfc.limits: Treat n=1,715 as the governor-item base in an adult-population survey, not as RV/LV results. Release omits exact question wording, reason for 285 outside the item base, item eligibility/screen, weighting variables/factors and exact MOE for n=1,715. ±2.6 pp is stated for the full n=2,000; release says item MOE is larger.

marquette.source: Marquette Law School Poll; Sep 2026 survey, release dated Sep 30.
marquette.body_evidence: One survey (Sep 16–23): 843 registered voters, MOE ±4.3 pp; LV subset n=692, MOE ±4.8 pp. Table 1 gives LV Tiffany 46/Crowley 49/undecided 5 and RV Tiffany 45/Crowley 46/undecided 9; pollster calls them party nominees.
marquette.dependence: LV and RV figures are two cuts of this same poll, not independent polls. The 692 LV sample likely overlaps/is nested in n=843 RV; release gives no respondent-level overlap/covariance. Do not combine as independent evidence or infer SE from published MOEs.

limits: No historical-bias research. No respondent microdata or full weighting specification captured.
